## Software

[**spyce**](https://github.com/khnhan/spyce) — Estimating a regression parameter
in a right-censored covariate setting under outcome-dependent censoring.

[**censcovpred**](https://github.com/khnhan/censcovpred) — Producing a prediction
interval under a right-censored covariate.
